note: Hand-maintained. Subcategories added after the audited 128-profile snapshot. Each one reuses an existing profile's booking model, questions and rules (baseSubcategoryId) and changes only its id, name and description. Bump revision when this list changes and add a migration that inserts the matching merchant_application_registry row.

variants.name: Wash and Fold
variants.specialtyNeeds: Weighed or bagged everyday laundry washed, dried and folded, with drop-off or collection and a turnaround window.

variants.name: Stain Removal
variants.specialtyNeeds: Per-item stain treatment with garment and fabric details, an honest outcome note and a turnaround window.

variants.name: Clothing Alterations and Repairs
variants.specialtyNeeds: Per-item alterations and repairs (hems, zips, fitting) with the garment, the requested change and a ready date.

variants.name: Curtain Cleaning
variants.specialtyNeeds: Curtains and drapes collected or dropped off, priced per panel or size, cleaned and returned within a turnaround window.

variants.name: Carpet Cleaning
variants.specialtyNeeds: Carpets and rugs collected or dropped off, priced per item or size, cleaned, dried and returned within a turnaround window.

variants.name: Wedding Gown Cleaning
variants.specialtyNeeds: Specialist cleaning of wedding and occasion gowns, per item, with fabric and embellishment notes and a ready date.

variants.name: Corporate and Uniform Laundry
variants.specialtyNeeds: Recurring laundry for businesses, staff uniforms and linen, collected and returned on an agreed schedule.

variants.name: Fumigation
variants.specialtyNeeds: On-site pest control and fumigation visits to homes and offices within a coverage area, with the treatment and re-entry time stated.

variants.name: Express Laundry (2-hour service)
variants.specialtyNeeds: Fast-turnaround laundry, ready in about two hours, with a cut-off time and capacity limit stated up front.

variants.name: Laundry Pickup and Delivery
variants.specialtyNeeds: Laundry collected from and returned to the customer's door in booked pickup and return windows.

variants.name: Garment Care and Finishing
variants.specialtyNeeds: Pressing, steaming, folding and finishing of garments, per item, ready for collection or return.

variants.name: Laundry Order Tracking
variants.specialtyNeeds: Laundry service where the customer follows each order's status from intake to return.
